description: Predict public benchmark performance across OpenEvals model parameter scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are aime2026 score, gpqa score, gsm8k score, hle score, hmmt2026 score, mmluPro score, and 4 more.
